events.summary: Owner approved 'KISA 수정' (2026-11-24), including minimal read-only RBAC on ClusterRole narwhal-portal for live KISA controls and no new Secret read permission. Added get/list only on security.istio.io/peerauthentications (KISA-TLS-01), batch/cronjobs (KISA-SEC-01 and KISA-IMG-02), and wgpolicyk8s.io/policyreports (KISA-IMG-02); no secrets rule was added.

Before this change, live measurement through kubectl proxy showed 6 static KISA controls (KISA-SEC-01/ETCD-02/IMG-01 fail, KISA-TLS-01/OBS-01/IMG-02 warn) with stale descriptions and KISA-RBAC-02 over-reporting 6 Critical bindings due to cross-rule wildcard combination and ignored apiGroups.

events.summary: Removed STATIC_STATUS and implemented live evaluators for KISA-ETCD-02, KISA-SEC-01 (PartialObjectMetadata Secret metadata degrading to not evaluated on 403), KISA-TLS-01 (including portLevelMtls), KISA-OBS-01 (routed external receivers + Falco/falcosidekick Ready), and KISA-IMG-02 (running pod :latest + ClusterPolicy + PolicyReport excluding deleted resources, 0-replica superseded ReplicaSets, and stale out-of-scope policy remnants).
